boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study environments at University of Oregon Libraries, with room features and access limitations noted from current official pages.

cards.title: Settle into the South Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Knight Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work and use the large second-floor quiet area; keep conversations for spaces outside the designated quiet zones.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet area in Knight Library with tables and chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library identifies the large South Reading Room on the second floor as one of its designated quiet, open-area study spaces.
cards.source_title: Knight Open Quiet Areas | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Designated quiet open-area seating; no reservation information is listed on the space page.

cards.title: Reserve a Knight group room
cards.subtitle: Knight Library, floors 2–4
cards.notes: Book a room for a credit-class discussion, study, or research session; if you walk in, leave when a later reservation takes priority.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with monitors and outlets for six to eight people.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library's group study rooms seat 6–8, include a television monitor and outlets, and are available to UO students for credit-class study, discussion, and research sessions.
cards.source_title: Knight Group Study Rooms | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservable by UO students; unreserved walk-up use is allowed only until a reservation holder needs the room.

cards.title: Book a compact two-person room
cards.subtitle: Knight Library, floors 2–4
cards.notes: Reserve one for a quiet partner session or focused individual work; keep sound low because the rooms are not especially soundproof.
cards.short_summary: Reservable small rooms designed for no more than two people.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library's small study rooms seat two, have outlets, and are intended for no more than two people.
cards.source_title: Knight Small Study Rooms | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservable; an unoccupied room may be used without a reservation, but a reservation holder has priority.

cards.title: Plan at GradSpace
cards.subtitle: Knight Library 148, first floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can request card access, then use flexible seating, monitors, and whiteboards to outline research or prepare presentations.
cards.short_summary: A graduate-only quiet room with writing and collaboration tools.
cards.evidence_claim: GradSpace in Knight Library 148 is reserved for UO graduate students and provides flexible seating, open monitors, and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Graduate students must request access; an approved UO ID card unlocks the door during regular library hours.

cards.title: Claim a graduate research room
cards.subtitle: Knight Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Graduate students doing extended library research can request a one- or two-seat room; submit the booking request at least two days ahead.
cards.short_summary: Four reservable individual research rooms for currently enrolled graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library has four graduate study rooms on the fourth floor, reservable only by currently enrolled graduate students for extensive library research.
cards.source_title: Knight Graduate Study Rooms | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Graduate-only; one person may reserve one room for an operating day, once per week, with requests due at least two days ahead.

cards.title: Work from the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Knight Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this open area when you need a campus computer, scanner, printer, or a table for active coursework and shared project tasks.
cards.short_summary: First-floor open study area equipped with computers, scanners, and printers.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor Knight Library Learning Commons is an open area with Macintosh and PC computers, scanners, black-and-white printers, color printers, and outlets.
cards.source_title: Knight Library Learning Commons | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open-area space; the official page lists equipment but no reservation requirement.

cards.entity_name: Knight Library Cinema Studies Classroom Lab
cards.title: Use the Cinema Studies Lab
cards.subtitle: Knight Library 267, second floor
cards.notes: Check the term schedule at the door and arrange required training before first use; plan computer-based work around instructional priority.
cards.short_summary: A computer classroom lab that keeps open hours for the UO community.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library's Cinema Studies Classroom Lab has open hours for UO students, faculty, and staff during most evenings and weekends, while weekdays prioritize academic instruction.
cards.source_title: Knight Library Cinema Studies Classroom Lab | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-time users must schedule training; the term-specific open schedule is posted at the lab door, and Cinema Studies classes have weekday priority.

cards.entity_name: Knight ABC (All Babies and Caregivers) Study Room
cards.title: Study in the ABC room
cards.subtitle: Knight Library 123, first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this two-seat room when coursework overlaps with caring for a small child; ask at circulation about available toy kits or diapers.
cards.short_summary: A reservable study room equipped to support caregivers of small children.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight Library's ABC Study Room is a reservable two-seat room with a sit-stand desk, baby gate, children's books, activities, and an inclusive-sized rocking chair.
cards.source_title: Knight ABC (All Babies and Caregivers) Study Room | UO Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservable room; contact the Knight Library Checkout & Reserves desk for assistance with reservations.

cards.title: Build a digital-project work session
cards.subtitle: Knight Library 121, first floor
cards.notes: Check the calendar before requesting the room, then use its conference-style setup, whiteboard, outlets, and video-conference capabilities for eligible work.
cards.short_summary: A reservable digital-scholarship workspace with workshop and private workroom seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Knight DREAM Lab 121 includes a workshop space and private workrooms, with whiteboard, outlets, and video-conference capabilities.
cards.access_notes: Check availability before requesting; spaces primarily serve UO faculty, graduate students, and staff engaged in specified digital scholarship and pedagogy work.

cards.title: Read beside the music collections
cards.subtitle: Douglass Room, Knight Library third floor
cards.notes: Use the open study area for reading or writing, then move to a listening carrel or workstation only if your project needs music and audio resources.
cards.short_summary: A natural-light study area within Knight Library's music and audio resource room.
cards.evidence_claim: The Douglass Room's open study area has natural light, comfortable seating, and abundant outlets; the room is open during all library hours.
cards.access_notes: Open during all library hours; Audio Production Studios require completion of the room's online training tutorials.
